label: WaterMelonControl
description: WaterMelonControl adds Karoo data page widgets for sideloaded media apps, including now playing, playback controls, tap-to-open, and device music volume control.
releaseNotes:
### Karoo 2 Diagnostics

- Adds temporary notification metadata logging for Karoo 2 investigation.
- Logs package, category, notification title/text extras, text lines, and media session token presence when the notification listener receives updates.
- This diagnostic logging is intended only for test builds and should be disabled before stable release.
